_meta.indication: ZYTIGA in combination with prednisone is indicated for the treatment of patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) who have received prior chemotherapy containing docetaxel.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter phase 3 trial; patients stratified and randomized 2:1 to abiraterone 1000 mg once daily plus prednisone 5 mg twice daily versus placebo plus prednisone.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who had previously received docetaxel-based chemotherapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: The primary endpoint was overall survival.
pivotal_trials.result: At the prespecified interim analysis, overall survival HR=0.646 (95% CI: 0.543, 0.768; p < 0.0001); median survival 14.8 months (abiraterone) vs 10.9 months (placebo) — a 3.9-month improvement.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (vs placebo) included joint swelling/discomfort (29.5% vs 23.4%), edema (26.7% vs 18.3%), muscle discomfort (26.2% vs 23.1%), hot flush (19.0% vs 16.8%) and diarrhea (17.6% vs 13.5%). Mineralocorticoid-excess effects: hypertension (8.5% vs 6.9%), low potassium (28.3% vs 19.8%), low phosphorus (23.8% vs 15.7%). Drug-associated hepatotoxicity (ALT or AST >5X ULN) reported in 2.3% of ZYTIGA patients.
target_moa: Abiraterone acetate is converted in vivo to abiraterone, an androgen biosynthesis inhibitor that inhibits CYP17 (17α-hydroxylase/C17,20-lyase), an enzyme required for androgen biosynthesis in testicular, adrenal and prostatic tumor tissues; inhibition decreases androgen (testosterone) production.
modality: Small molecule (CYP17 inhibitor; abiraterone acetate is the acetyl ester of abiraterone)

advisory_committee.vote: This NDA was not presented at a meeting of the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because there were no issues that needed discussion.

description.text: Incorporated final overall survival analysis data from study COU-AA-302 into Clinical Studies section and fulfilled postmarketing commitment

citations.quote: - Incorporating into the “Clinical Studies” section of the package insert, final analysis data from study COU-AA-302, a phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of abiraterone acetate (CB7630) plus prednisone in asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. In addition, this application fulfills a postmarketing commitment (1973-1) to submit datasets and the final analysis of overall survival for COU-AA-302.

description.text: Added indication for Zytiga in combination with prednisone for metastatic high-risk castration-sensitive prostate cancer

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for the use of Zytiga in combination with prednisone for the treatment of patients with metastatic high-risk castration-sensitive prostate cancer.

summary.text: Traditional (full) approval of this 505(b) NDA under Priority Review, based on a statistically significant overall survival benefit in the phase 3 trial COU-AA-301; no accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track or orphan designation was stated, and the application was not taken to an advisory committee.

citations.quote: The pivotal trial COU-AA-301 met the study objective by showing a hazard ratio of 0.646 (95% CI: 0.543 – 0.768, p-value < 0.0001) for the abiraterone acetate arm versus the placebo arm in overall survival at the interim analysis with 69% information (552 deaths). The median survival time was 14.8 months in the abiraterone acetate arm compared to 10.9 months in the placebo arm. The finding was confirmed by the updated overall survival analysis with 775 deaths (97% of the planned number of deaths for final analysis), with a HR of 0.740 (95% CI: 0.638-0.859; p < 0.0001) and a median survival of 15.8 months versus 11.2 months for the abiraterone acetate arm and the placebo arm, respectively. Furthermore, subgroup analyses showed consistent results in favor of abiraterone acetate. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the findings of the primary analysis. There are no major statistical issues in the efficacy analyses.

This NDA was not presented at a meeting of the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because there were no issues that needed discussion. The benefit risk assessment is straightforward and clearly favorable for the indicated population.

requirement.text: 1748-1: Perform an in vitro screen to determine if abiraterone is an inhibitor of human CYP2C8; based on results, a clinical drug-drug interaction trial may be needed.
